functions.name: memory
functions.description: Store and retrieve notes across conversations in files under /memories. Commands: view (a directory or file, optionally a line range), create (a file with file_text), str_replace, insert (after line insert_line), delete (a file or directory) and rename (old_path to new_path). Check the directory before starting a task.

path.description: The file or directory the command applies to (view, create, str_replace, insert, delete).

view_range.description: view only: [start_line, end_line], 1-indexed; an end line of -1 reads to the end of the file.

file_text.description: create only: the content of the file.

old_str.description: str_replace only: the text to replace, matched exactly.

new_str.description: str_replace only: the replacement; leave it out to delete old_str.

insert_line.description: insert only: the line after which to insert; 0 inserts at the start of the file.

insert_text.description: insert only: the text to insert.

old_path.description: rename only: the path to rename.
